target_customer: Sales teams using Salesforce and other CRMs
problem: CRM contact data goes stale, so salespeople waste time on wrong emails, titles and phone numbers.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for CRM data refresh
product_category: CRM data cleaning and contact enrichment

founders.name: Gerald Fong
founders.background_notes: No further background on the YC page.

founders.name: Naveen Krishnamurthi
founders.background_notes: No further background on the YC page.

competitors.name: Salesforce Data.com Clean
competitors.what: Data quality and enrichment inside Salesforce

competitors.name: Dun & Bradstreet NetProspex
competitors.what: Contact data and Workbench data hygiene platform

competitors.name: InsideView
competitors.what: Launched Refresh in 2016 for automated CRM account cleansing

competitors.name: ZoomInfo
competitors.what: Sales intelligence data with Salesforce enrichment

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed to aggregate public and private contact sources and write back into CRMs reliably; data coverage was harder than the software.

defensibility.rationale: Established data vendors had larger datasets and bundled hygiene tools, while Elucify's edge was a convenient one click refresh.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept adding hygiene features through 2016; Elucify was acquired by Circleback in 2018.

market_need_then: Sales teams complained about decaying CRM data and vendors were adding hygiene features, showing paid demand.

branding.domain_note: elucify.com now redirects to a Circleback ContactCloud signup page.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission statement that good data is the foundation of effective sales organizations.

branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch covered it in March 2016; no evidence of fan culture.

brand_strength.rationale: Only a TechCrunch article and a Circleback acquisition note exist; the name resembles elucidate and similar names such as Elucidat and Elucid.

outcome_analysis: Elucify was a Winter 2016 YC company that refreshed Salesforce contact data. It sold into a market where Salesforce, D&B, InsideView and ZoomInfo already offered hygiene tools. Circleback acquired it in 2018 for undisclosed terms, so the result looks like a small acquisition rather than a failure, but the price and reason are not public.
notes: Directory status is Inactive but the company was acquired by Circleback in 2018, so exit is acquisition; the acquisition is stated on the YC page and the Circleback press release headline. The only funding figure, about $120K seed in March 2016 from Y Combinator, appears only on CB Insights and is unverified. Exact acquisition date and price not found. The company site redirects to Circleback (dead as an independent site).
